picks.title: Meta unveils AI-powered game tools for mobile devices and browsers; announces VR Glasses with day-one Unity support
picks.rationale: Platform-level launch: Horizon Centre/Studio turn prompts into playable 2D/3D games on mobile and web, plus a new Unity-supported device target. Actionable for devs and not previously covered in games.
picks.excerpt: Horizon Centre and Horizon Studio will "make it easier to turn your ideas into playable 2D and 3D games"

picks.title: SecretSauce Labs' Simon Davis on leaving games behind and solving AI's brand consistency problem
picks.rationale: Fresh (09-29) industry signal: a game studio (Wearemighty) quits game development to rebrand as an AI content-tech company focused on brand/art consistency. Shows where studio art pipelines and talent are migrating.
picks.excerpt: Wearemighty is leaving game development behind and rebranding as SecretSauce Labs, shifting its focus entirely to AI content technology

picks.title: 원스토어, AI 게임 등록 전면 개방
picks.rationale: Freshest item (09-29): a Korean app store opens a dedicated AI-games storefront and Console registration to all developers, with web-game SDK monetization; a real distribution channel for AI-made games. Exact URL not in published history (only ?news=321275 is).
picks.excerpt: 원스토어가 AI 게임 전용관을 모든 개발자에게 개방하고 원콘솔에서 AI 기반 게임 등록을 시작한다. 10월 초 전용관 명칭을 'AI 게임'으로 바꿔 앱 하단에 상시 배치하고 웹게임 SDK로 수익화도 지원하며, 코딩 경험 없는 개발자도 AI로 만든 게임을 등록할 수 있다.

picks.title: 컴투스플랫폼, 하이브 액실 30일 출시
picks.rationale: Launches today (09-30): Com2uS Platform's Hive Axil lets devs run backend config, payments and analytics via natural-language prompts with a Codex plugin; AI as a real live-ops tool. Exact URL not in published history.
picks.excerpt: 컴투스플랫폼이 도쿄 AI 게임 개발 행사에서 차세대 백엔드 플랫폼 '하이브 액실'을 공개했다. 9월 30일 정식 출시되며 자연어 프롬프트로 백엔드 설정·결제·데이터 분석 등 라이브 운영 기능을 다루고, 코덱스 플러그인 연결로 개발 효율을 높인다.

picks.title: 19 AI Agents Clash in Intense StarCraft Battle: GPT-6 Sweeps All Matches but Still Fails to Beat Novice Human Players
picks.rationale: Novel benchmark (Brood War Bench, 171 matches across 19 agent configs) showing frontier agents still play at beginner level in RTS; AI is the subject and the tool, not a theme. No prior games coverage; adds a third distinct outlet. Chosen over Qualcomm Snapdragon (same chip launch already ran in gadgets 09-23), the etoday roundup (overlaps PUBG Ally) and Limerence (AI only as story theme).
picks.excerpt: Developer Ben Swerdlow's Brood War Bench ran 19 AI agent configurations through 171 round-robin StarCraft: Brood War matches; GPT-6 Astra went 18-0, yet no model played above beginner level against humans. (Off-list exception: no allowed-domain coverage.)
